Event Watch Cfg_DetectMultipleEvent functionality added ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- The Event Watch instruction provides configurable monitoring of an event queue that can be used to identify an event's existence within the queue as well as location of the event in the queue.
Instruction Execution: ----- Level
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description 1011 Invalid queue pointer (outside array) 1015 Cfg_Type invalid (<-1) 1016 Cfg_ID invalid (<-1) 1017 Cfg_Category invalid (<-1) 1018 Cfg_Action invalid (<-1) 1019 Cfg_Value invalid (<-1)
Revision Notes: ----- 2.2.00 - Cfg_DetectMultipleEvent functionality added 2.1.00 - Cfg_ReArm, Cmd_Arm functionality fixed 2.0.00 - Added Inf_Lib. Replaced TND with JMP. Initialize on First Scan. 1.1.00 - Fixed anomaly where valid events could be skipped. Cfg_Rearm now automatically rearms instruction. 1.0.00 – Release
